_comment: Read by generate.py when it fills in the generated content (element summaries, category lists, attribute table, indexes): where the source is, and how the generated links are written so they match the rest of the source. Metadata, CSS, the anchors block and the front page are in master/index.bs and master/header.include.

source._comment: Read by generate.py, which builds from the .bs source in master/. definitions: the files the generated content (element summaries, category lists, attribute table, indexes) is made from, the same list publish.xml had; href is relative to the root of the repository.

typed_link_policy._comment: exact: typed only when Bikeshed lands on the same id. section: also when it lands on the generated dfn in the same section (element summary box, IDL block).

_comment_single_page_drop_headings: Headings Bikeshed writes that today's single page does not have (the 'IDL Index' heading above the IDL appendix). singlepage.py replaces each by an empty span keeping its id, and drops its table of contents entry. Same list as drop_headings in config/svg2-split.json.
